prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original static reward panorama for RevealLine, a fictional FPV Front territory-reveal arcade game. Create one highly detailed modern pixel-art illustration, approximately 2:1 landscape, full bleed, no text or UI. Scene: Listening Court, an abandoned military communications courtyard in an eastern-European setting at cool early morning, low weathered brick workshops, a quiet antenna mast, broken paving, birch trees and two open passages into a distant misty landscape. Distinct palette of pale cyan mist, moss green and muted copper light, with crisp dark silhouettes and readable areas of light. Main subject: one small recognizable Ukrainian FPV quadcopter hovering over the foreground courtyard, accurately readable open X-frame, strapped battery, front camera, four three-blade rotors, modest blue-and-yellow identification tape. The drone should occupy only a small part of the panorama, with the environment telling the story. Small abandoned or disabled hostile radio equipment can appear unobtrusively; no combat injury. Style: original high-detail pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, coherent subtle dithering, rich environmental storytelling, not a screenshot or imitation of any commercial game. Composition: broad left-to-right depth, distinct near/mid/far planes, clear large shapes readable as black cover is gradually revealed. Scenery is illustration, not an exact collision map; do not draw a grid, borders, targeting reticle, letters, labels, brand logos or watermarks. Ukrainian drone/equipment must have no Z markings. No flags dominating the frame, no large characters, gore, explosions or copied art.
